proof_explanation: The repaired negate function now returns !value, implementing total Boolean negation over the complete boolean domain. This satisfies the postcondition ensures result == !value: for negate(true) it returns !true = false, and for negate(false) it returns !false = true. The implementation is deterministic and covers all possible boolean inputs, establishing the Boolean negation law.

seeded_attack.reason: The seeded attack violates the Boolean negation law. A compliant implementation must return the logical negation of the input value (result == !value) for all boolean inputs. Any implementation that fails to satisfy this postcondition breaches the total Boolean negation requirement.
